entities.summary: Metropolitan University Prague is one of the oldest and largest private universities in the Czech Republic. It was founded in 2001 as the University of Public Administration and International Relations. It has been ranked by the Czech Ministry of Education as the highest quality social science institution in the Czech Republic.
